answer: An identity is admitted only if it posts a 30-credit bond or presents a unique hardware credential issued once per device at the glacier datacenter. Forging N identities locks 30N credits, forfeits 70 percent of the bond per epoch, and waits 12 epochs per identity. Splitting identities raises marginal cost to 30 credits each, and any one fraud penalty applies to the shared lagoon pool, with independent jurors flagging each pearl of duplicate evidence.
